Find a GitHub API token

Source: R/api.R
gh_token.Rd

Looks for a GitHub personal access token (PAT) in the following order: the token argument itself, the GITHUB_PAT environment variable, the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable, and–if the gitcreds package is installed–the git credential store (the same one used by the gh package and the gh command line client).

Usage

gh_token(token = NULL)

Arguments

token

Optional character scalar. If non-empty, it is returned as-is.

Value

A character scalar with the token, or the empty string "" when no token was found (requests then go out unauthenticated).

Details

All API-calling functions in aitracking take a token argument that defaults to gh_token(), so in most setups authentication "just works": either because GITHUB_PAT/GITHUB_TOKEN is set, or because a token is available from the git credential store.

Unauthenticated requests are possible but heavily rate-limited by GitHub (60 requests/hour versus 5,000/hour with a token).

See also

Other api: gh_api()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
gh_token() # What token would be used?
} # }
